About Phull Insights

Operator accountability, applied to advisory work.

The practice exists to bring evidence before opinion—and a plan the team can run without the consultant in the room—to a deliberately limited number of engagements.

Pupsi Phull, founder

Pupsi is an operations director with two decades across regulated manufacturing, international logistics and multi-site distribution. His experience spans current supply-chain leadership in global MedTech, a 16-branch industrial distribution network and technical/value-added services with a £230m revenue scope.

That range is the basis of the proposition: understand the journey in the data, make uncertainty visible and design recommendations that an accountable operator could implement.

Founder-led delivery is not a layer of account management. The person framing the diagnostic remains accountable for the reasoning.

How engagements are delivered

Phull Insights takes on a limited number of engagements. Scoping, diagnosis and executive synthesis are founder-led. Any specialist support or associate involvement is agreed in advance and remains within the defined data and governance boundary.

Credentials

  • Executive MBA, Cranfield School of Management
  • BSc, De Montfort University
  • PRINCE2 Practitioner
  • Six Sigma
  • PGCert in Sustainability (in progress)
